# orientTrianglesTest.py

You can view and download this file on Github: [orientTrianglesTest.py](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/tree/master/python/TestModels/orientTrianglesTest.py)

```{code-block} python
:linenos:

#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
# This is an EXUDYN example
#
# Details:  graphics.OrientTriangles and graphics.CheckTriangleOrientation (#2281): triangles of a brick, a cylinder
#           and a sphere with 40 % of them flipped at random are oriented back, consistently and outward; of two bricks,
#           one inverted, both end outward; an open surface keeps the orientation of most of its triangles; three
#           triangles on one edge are reported as non-manifold; an STL file with flipped triangles, in which every
#           triangle has points of its own, is repaired by FromSTLfileASCII(..., orientTriangles=True). The primitives
#           of exudyn.graphics are consistent and outward.
#
# Author:   Johannes Gerstmayr
# Date:     2026-10-18
#
# Copyright:This file is part of Exudyn. Exudyn is free software. You can redistribute it and/or modify it under the terms of the Exudyn license. See 'LICENSE.txt' for more details.
#
#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

import exudyn as exu
import exudyn.graphics as graphics
import numpy as np
import os

testError = 0
def Check(condition, message):
    global testError
    if not condition:
        exu.Print('orientTrianglesTest: ' + message)
        testError += 1

def Triangles(g):
    return np.asarray(graphics.Triangles6ToTriangles(graphics.SpheresToTriangleList(g))['triangles']).reshape((-1, 3))

def Scrambled(g, fraction=0.4, seed=1):
    """the TriangleList with a fraction of its triangles flipped at random"""
    g = dict(graphics.Triangles6ToTriangles(graphics.SpheresToTriangleList(g)))
    triangles = Triangles(g).copy()
    flip = np.random.default_rng(seed).random(len(triangles)) < fraction
    triangles[flip] = triangles[flip][:, [1, 0, 2]]
    g['triangles'] = triangles
    return g

def Area(g):
    points = np.asarray(g['points'], dtype=float).reshape((-1, 3))
    t = Triangles(g)
    return np.linalg.norm(np.cross(points[t[:, 1]] - points[t[:, 0]], points[t[:, 2]] - points[t[:, 0]]), axis=1)

u = 0.
#closed shapes: oriented back to the original, which is outward
for name, g in [('brick', graphics.Brick(size=[1, 2, 3])),
                ('cylinder', graphics.Cylinder(pAxis=[0, 0, 0], vAxis=[0, 0, 1], radius=0.5, nTiles=16)),
                ('sphere', graphics.Sphere(radius=1, nTiles=16))]:
    original = graphics.Triangles6ToTriangles(graphics.SpheresToTriangleList(g))
    bad = Scrambled(original)
    Check(graphics.CheckTriangleOrientation(bad)['flipped'] > 0, name + ': the flipped triangles are not found')
    fixed, report = graphics.OrientTriangles(bad, returnReport=True)
    proper = Area(original) > 1e-12 #degenerate triangles at the poles have no orientation
    Check(np.array_equal(Triangles(fixed)[proper], Triangles(original)[proper]), name + ': not oriented back')
    Check(graphics.CheckTriangleOrientation(fixed)['consistent'], name + ': not consistent after OrientTriangles')
    u += report['flipped']

#two bricks, the second inverted: both outward
brick = graphics.Brick(size=[1, 1, 1])
inverted = graphics.InvertTriangles(graphics.Brick(centerPoint=[3, 0, 0], size=[1, 1, 1], addNormals=True))
fixed, report = graphics.OrientTriangles(graphics.MergeTriangleLists(brick, inverted), returnReport=True)
Check(report['components'] == 2 and report['closedComponents'] == 2 and report['invertedComponents'] == 1,
      'two bricks: ' + str(report))
Check(graphics.CheckTriangleOrientation(fixed)['consistent'], 'two bricks: not outward')
u += report['flipped']

#an open surface keeps the orientation of most of its triangles
board = graphics.CheckerBoard(point=[0, 0, 0], size=2, nTiles=4)
fixed, report = graphics.OrientTriangles(Scrambled(board, fraction=0.3), returnReport=True)
Check(np.array_equal(Triangles(fixed), Triangles(board)) and report['openEdges'] > 0, 'open surface: ' + str(report))
u += report['flipped']

#three triangles on one edge: non-manifold, reported
fan = graphics.FromPointsAndTrigs([[0, 0, 0], [1, 0, 0], [0, 1, 0], [0, 0, 1], [0, -1, 0]], [[0, 1, 2], [0, 1, 3], [1, 0, 4]])
report = graphics.CheckTriangleOrientation(fan)
Check(report['nonManifoldEdges'] == 1, 'non-manifold edge not reported: ' + str(report))

#an STL file with flipped triangles; every triangle of an STL file has points of its own
from exudyn.basicUtilities import OutputFilePath
fileName = OutputFilePath('orientTrianglesTest.stl', 'orientTrianglesTest') #in the output directory, if one is set
if os.path.dirname(fileName) != '':
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(fileName), exist_ok=True)
graphics.ExportSTL(Scrambled(graphics.Brick(size=[1, 2, 3])), fileName)
imported = graphics.FromSTLfileASCII(fileName)
repaired = graphics.FromSTLfileASCII(fileName, orientTriangles=True)
Check(not graphics.CheckTriangleOrientation(imported)['consistent'], 'STL: the flipped triangles are not found')
reportSTL = graphics.CheckTriangleOrientation(repaired)
Check(reportSTL['consistent'] and reportSTL['closedComponents'] == 1, 'STL: not repaired: ' + str(reportSTL))
normals = np.asarray(repaired['normals']).reshape((-1, 3))
points = np.asarray(repaired['points']).reshape((-1, 3))
Check(np.all(np.einsum('ij,ij->i', normals, points) > 0), 'STL: normals not outward') #a brick about the origin
os.remove(fileName)

#the primitives of exudyn.graphics are consistent and outward
for name, g in [('Cylinder', graphics.Cylinder(radius=0.1, nTiles=12)), ('Torus', graphics.Torus(point=[0, 0, 0], axis=[0, 0, 1], radiusMajor=0.3, radiusMinor=0.05)),
                ('SolidOfRevolution', graphics.SolidOfRevolution(pAxis=[0, 0, 0], vAxis=[0, 0, 1],
                                                                 contour=[[0, 0.1], [0.3, 0.2], [0.5, 0.05]], nTiles=12)),
                ('SolidExtrusion', graphics.SolidExtrusion(vertices=[[-0.4, -0.4], [0.4, -0.4], [0.4, 0.4], [-0.4, 0.4]],
                                                           segments=[[0, 1], [1, 2], [2, 3], [3, 0]], height=0.2)),
                ('BrickRound', graphics.Brick(size=[0.4, 0.2, 0.1], roundness=0.2, nTiles=8)),
                ('Sphere', graphics.Sphere(radius=0.2, nTiles=8)), ('Arrow', graphics.Arrow(pAxis=[0, 0, 0], vAxis=[0.5, 0, 0], radius=0.02))]:
    report = graphics.CheckTriangleOrientation(graphics.Triangles6ToTriangles(graphics.SpheresToTriangleList(g)))
    Check(report['consistent'] and report['inconsistentEdges'] == 0, name + ': ' + str(report))

u += testError
exu.Print('solution of orientTrianglesTest=', u)

exu.sys['testResult'] = u
```
